remarks: Stunning Ocean  &  Harbor-View Retreat at Hollywood by the Sea   Welcome to 2916 Lakeshore Court, a one-of-a-kind coastal escape in Oxnard's highly desirable Hollywood by the Sea / Silver strand neighborhood. This fully furnished 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers a front-row seat to unobstructed water, sunsets and Channel Islands views--the perfect vantage point to watch every boat as it enters and leaves the harbor, framed by unforgettable sunsets. Inside, the living room showcases a custom tile fireplace, expansive picture windows, and wood plank ceilings that draw your eye to the sparkling water beyond.
